title: Molten Obsidian Peaks
description: A surreal landscape featuring jagged, glossy black crystalline formations rising from a dense field of vibrant multicolored bokeh-like orbs. A dark circular void hovers in a smoky, atmospheric sky with purple and green tones.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy landscape with sharp jagged glossy black obsidian crystal formations emerging from a vast field of glowing multicolored circular bokeh orbs in teal, orange, yellow and green. A dark circular void floats in a smoky atmospheric sky with deep purple and greenish hues, dramatic lighting, painterly texture, mysterious and otherworldly atmosphere.
